title: BONDERITE® S-ST 6930 AERO – 55 GAL
description: Environmentally advantaged, low odor, thixotropic stripper activated by hydrogen peroxide. Developed for effective stripping of epoxies, epoxy primers, polyurethanes and similar catalyzed paints. Complies fully with NESHAP and meets corrosivity requirements of TT-R-2918A.
